title: SFX -- key item get (ta-da)
_note: Receiving a KEY item (a wick-key, a quest token, a toggle lamp): the common pickup chirp grown into a small 'da-da-DAA' -- two pickups and a held, bell-lit landing on the tonic. Bigger than world-pickup, far smaller than a Gleam. ~0.9 s. Render --tail 0.35 to .wav, then ffmpeg -af volume=-3dB -> .mp3.
